versions.subject: rules: bitsadmin coverage
versions.detection:
selection:
    Image|endswith: '\bitsadmin.exe'
    CommandLine|contains:
        - ' /transfer '
        - ' /create '
        - ' /addfile '
selection_folder:
    CommandLine|contains: 
        - 'C:\Users\Public\'
        - '%public%'
        - 'C:\Windows\Temp\'
        - '%temp%'
        - 'C:\ProgramData\'
        - '%ProgramData%'
condition: all of selection*
